checks.evidence: Japanese throughout: “担当者による追加資料の要求は任意ですが”.

“求められた場合、申請者は5営業日以内に提出しなければなりません。”

ratings.reason: Concisely preserves optional requesting and mandatory submission within five business days if requested.

checks.evidence: Japanese throughout: “担当者は必要に応じて”.
“必要に応じて追加資料を求めることができ” retains permission but adds a need-based qualification absent from the source.
“申請者は求められた場合、5営業日以内に提出しなければなりません。”

unsupported_claims: “必要に応じて” qualifies the requesting permission by need; the source states permission without that qualification.
ratings.reason: The submission rule is intact, but the added need-based qualification changes the scope of the requesting permission.

cases.preference_reason: Preserves explicit optionality without adding a condition on requesting documents.
